name: How long does sliding door draft repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does sliding door draft repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door draft repair depends on the extent of the damage. Minor repairs, such as replacing weatherstripping or adjusting rollers, can often be completed within a few hours. More involved repairs, like track replacement or addressing significant frame issues, might require a full day or multiple visits. A professional can provide a more precise timeline after an inspection.
